name: File email to SharePoint
description: Takes an email from "Mail dropped in a folder" and files it into the SharePoint team library: a subfolder per email under sharepoint_folder holding Email.pdf and the attachments in their original format (inline images stay inside Email.pdf, cloud links are skipped and listed), then moves the email to filed_folder (default Filed). Any failure leaves the email where it is, so it is retried. The 300 s timeout covers a whole email, so one with very large or many attachments can exceed it.
